create_SegmentationTask: create a SegmentationTask for semantic segmentation with configurable loss and background exclusion
create_RegressionSegmentationTask: create a RegressionSegmentationTask for pixel-wise regression with L2 loss and valid label masking
create_PanopticSegmentationTask: create a PanopticSegmentationTask combining semantic and instance segmentation with small object filtering
run_SegmentationTask_loss: run SegmentationTask.get_loss_and_aux to compute loss and auxiliary metrics from model logits and batch labels
run_SegmentationTask_inference: run SegmentationTask.get_infer_postprocessing_fn to get a postprocessing function that produces predictions and probabilities
